name: Screen lock timeout ≤ 300 seconds
description: Clear desk and clear screen. Every account on the machine has to lock within five minutes, and a timeout of 0, the screen saver never starting, fails.
query: SELECT count(*) AS configured, min(cast(value AS integer)) AS shortest, max(cast(value AS integer)) AS longest FROM plist WHERE (path = '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.screensaver.plist' OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Preferences/com.apple.screensaver.plist' OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Preferences/ByHost/com.apple.screensaver.%') AND key = 'idleTime';
